name: azure-devops-work-items
title: Azure DevOps Work Items
description: Browse, create, and update Azure DevOps work items. Change states in bulk, view inline images and attachments, and create linked branches with one keystroke.
author: stoumann

commands.name: my-work-items
commands.title: My Work Items
commands.description: Browse work items assigned to you, change states, and create linked branches

preferences.name: organization
preferences.title: Organization
preferences.description: Your Azure DevOps organization slug (e.g. 'contoso' from dev.azure.com/contoso)

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Your Email
preferences.description: The email used in Azure DevOps (used to resolve @Me in WIQL queries)

preferences.name: pat
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Create at https://dev.azure.com/{org}/_usersSettings/tokens with Work Items (Read & Write) and Code (Read & Write) scopes. After saving these credentials, open the extension to configure projects, states, types, and branch defaults.
